claims.text: The orion-research-harness exposes eight implemented capability kinds. Three are broker-mediated host capabilities validated in broker.py: LLM_COMPLETE (string content, optional model_id/response_id), WEB_SEARCH (items with non-empty content and source_uri), VERIFY_EVIDENCE (boolean passed; a pass requires at least one certificate id). Five are local kinds in local_tools.py: FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, FILE_LIST, SHELL, PYTHON. There is no CapabilityKind enum; kinds are strings.

Every implemented capability kind is exercised by at least one test: WEB_SEARCH (test_harness.py:25-29, test_hardening.py:55), LLM_COMPLETE (test_harness.py:190, test_hardening.py:159), VERIFY_EVIDENCE (test_hardening.py:197-217), FILE_WRITE (test_harness.py:61), FILE_READ (test_harness.py:65-69, test_hardening.py:249-255,310), FILE_LIST (test_local_limits.py:24), PYTHON (test_hardening.py:258-287, test_local_limits.py:43), SHELL (test_local_limits.py:62). The suite passes 30/30 on Python 3.11.

The handoff text in cli.py line 52 names GITHUB or other custom capabilities, but no provider requests a GITHUB capability, local_tools.py does not service it, and no test exercises it. GITHUB is documentation-only surface, not an implemented capability kind; the implemented and tested set is exactly the eight kinds.

Recent history of packages/orion-research-harness (through PR #728 merge d7312bc) only hardened replay/receipt mechanics (canonical JSON replay equality, host capability failure control signal export); no capability kind was added or removed. The eight-kind capability set is current.

evidence.content: The harness protocol has no CapabilityKind enum; capabilities are plain string kinds. Broker-mediated kinds are declared in packages/orion-research-harness/src/orion_research_harness/broker.py: LLM_COMPLETE (line 96, content must be a string, optional model_id/response_id), WEB_SEARCH (line 134, items with non-empty content and source_uri, array domain_ids), VERIFY_EVIDENCE (line 192, boolean passed, certificate_ids array, passing requires a certificate). Local kinds are declared in packages/orion-research-harness/src/orion_research_harness/local_tools.py lines 13-20: FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, FILE_LIST, SHELL, PYTHON.

Test coverage per capability kind, verified by grep of packages/orion-research-harness/tests/: WEB_SEARCH in test_harness.py lines 25-29 and test_hardening.py line 55; LLM_COMPLETE in test_harness.py line 190 and test_hardening.py line 159; VERIFY_EVIDENCE in test_hardening.py test_verification_pass_requires_real_certificate_and_boolean lines 197-217; FILE_WRITE test_harness.py line 61; FILE_READ test_harness.py lines 65-69 and test_hardening.py lines 249-255 and 310; FILE_LIST test_local_limits.py line 24; PYTHON test_hardening.py lines 258-287 and test_local_limits.py line 43; SHELL test_local_limits.py line 62. The suite passes 30/30 under pytest on Python 3.11.

Adversarial omission check: the CLI handoff text (packages/orion-research-harness/src/orion_research_harness/cli.py line 52) mentions GITHUB or other custom capabilities as host-serviced kinds, but no GITHUB capability is requested by any provider in broker.py, serviced by local_tools.py, or exercised by any test under packages/orion-research-harness/tests/. GITHUB is documentation-only surface, not an implemented capability kind. All eight implemented kinds (LLM_COMPLETE, WEB_SEARCH, VERIFY_EVIDENCE, FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, FILE_LIST, SHELL, PYTHON) have at least one test.

Freshness check via git log on packages/orion-research-harness at branch head d7312bc (merge of PR #728, harden ORION research harness): latest capability-surface commits are 0dc487e0 (regression tests for canonical JSON replay), 09581ee4 (canonical replay equality fix), 60ffab2c (export host capability failure control signal). None of these adds or removes a capability kind; the eight-kind set is current as of 2026-08-21.
